# Inlining a slice sum inside an outer loop must not move vector zeroing
# ahead of its feature check. Inspect the code even on an AVX512 host,
# where an unguarded instruction would otherwise execute successfully.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'nested SIMD guard inspection needs amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOAMD64=v1
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd

cd checker
go build -o $WORK/checkguard .
cd ../m
exec $WORK/checkguard safe.txt avx512
stdout '^guard excludes vectors avx512$'
exec $WORK/checkguard safe-alignment.txt avx512
stdout '^guard excludes vectors avx512$'
! exec $WORK/checkguard before-branch.txt avx512
stderr 'feature check is not followed by TESTL and JE'
! exec $WORK/checkguard alignment-before-vector.txt avx512
stderr 'feature check is not followed by TESTL and JE'
! exec $WORK/checkguard alignment-before-clobber.txt avx512
stderr 'feature check is not followed by TESTL and JE'
! exec $WORK/checkguard false-target.txt avx512
stderr 'vector instruction reachable with avx512 false'
logos build -gcflags=-d=ssa/check/on -o $WORK/exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.nestedU8$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VPADDB'
stdout 'VMOVDQU8'
cp stdout $WORK/u8.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/u8.txt avx512
stdout '^guard excludes vectors avx512$'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.nestedI32$' $WORK/exe
stdout 'VPADDD'
stdout 'VPMASKMOVD'
cp stdout $WORK/i32.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/i32.txt avx2
stdout '^guard excludes vectors avx2$'
exec $WORK/exe
stdout '^nested sums ok$'
env GODEBUG=cpu.avx2=off,cpu.avx512f=off
exec $WORK/exe
stdout '^nested sums ok$'

# The shared backend must preserve the same guard for ordinary Go input
# under both drivers. Keep the feature methods as calls so this fixture
# uses the same explicit guard oracle as the inlined loGo/s reduction.
cd ../g
env GODEBUG=
go build -gcflags='-l -d=ssa/check/on' -o $WORK/go-exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.zeroU8$' $WORK/go-exe
cp stdout $WORK/go-u8.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/go-u8.txt avx512
stdout '^guard excludes vectors avx512$'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.zeroI32$' $WORK/go-exe
cp stdout $WORK/go-i32.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/go-i32.txt avx2
stdout '^guard excludes vectors avx2$'
exec $WORK/go-exe
stdout '^guarded Go zeros ok$'
env GODEBUG=cpu.avx2=off,cpu.avx512f=off
exec $WORK/go-exe
stdout '^guarded Go zeros ok$'
logos build -gcflags='-l -d=ssa/check/on' -o $WORK/logos-go-exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.zeroU8$' $WORK/logos-go-exe
cp stdout $WORK/logos-go-u8.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/logos-go-u8.txt avx512
stdout '^guard excludes vectors avx512$'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.zeroI32$' $WORK/logos-go-exe
cp stdout $WORK/logos-go-i32.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/logos-go-i32.txt avx2
stdout '^guard excludes vectors avx2$'
exec $WORK/logos-go-exe
stdout '^guarded Go zeros ok$'
env GODEBUG=
exec $WORK/logos-go-exe
stdout '^guarded Go zeros ok$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nestedguard

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func sumU8(xs []uint8) uint8 { return xs.sum() }
func sumI32(xs []int32) int32 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func nestedU8(chunks [][]uint8) uint8 {
	var total uint8
	for _, xs := range chunks {
		total += sumU8(xs)
	}
	return total
}

//go:noinline
func nestedI32(chunks [][]int32) int32 {
	var total int32
	for _, xs := range chunks {
		total += sumI32(xs)
	}
	return total
}

func main() {
	lengths := []int{0, 1, 7, 8, 9, 63, 64, 65, 130}
	bytes := make([][]uint8, len(lengths))
	words := make([][]int32, len(lengths))
	var wantU8 uint8
	var wantI32 int32
	for i, n := range lengths {
		bytes[i] = make([]uint8, n)
		words[i] = make([]int32, n)
		for j := range n {
			bytes[i][j] = uint8(j*37 + n)
			words[i][j] = int32(j*131 - n*29)
			wantU8 += bytes[i][j]
			wantI32 += words[i][j]
		}
	}
	if nestedU8(bytes) != wantU8 || nestedI32(words) != wantI32 {
		panic("nested sum differs from scalar oracle")
	}
	fmt.Println("nested sums ok")
}

-- checker/go.mod --
module example.com/guardcheck

go 1.27

-- checker/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

type instruction struct {
	op   string
	args string
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		panic("usage: checkguard <objdump> <avx2|avx512>")
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	mode := os.Args[2]
	if mode != "avx2" && mode != "avx512" {
		panic("unrecognized feature: " + mode)
	}
	var code []instruction
	labels := make(map[string]int)
	guard := -1
	hasVector := false
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		if len(fields) < 4 || !strings.HasPrefix(fields[1], "0x") {
			continue
		}
		inst := instruction{fields[3], strings.Join(fields[4:], " ")}
		labels[fields[1]] = len(code)
		if inst.op == "CALL" && strings.Contains(inst.args, "X86Features."+strings.ToUpper(mode)+"(SB)") {
			if guard >= 0 {
				panic("multiple feature checks in fixture")
			}
			guard = len(code)
		}
		hasVector = hasVector || strings.HasPrefix(inst.op, "V") || strings.HasPrefix(inst.op, "K")
		code = append(code, inst)
	}
	if guard < 0 || !hasVector {
		panic("missing feature check or vector instruction")
	}
	// Alignment may insert no-ops between the call, test, and branch.
	// Skip only those instructions; real work here could execute a vector
	// too early or change the flags that determine the false-feature edge.
	skipAlignment := func(i int) int {
		for i < len(code) {
			switch code[i].op {
			case "NOP", "NOPL", "NOPW":
				i++
			default:
				return i
			}
		}
		return i
	}
	test := skipAlignment(guard + 1)
	branch := skipAlignment(test + 1)
	if test >= len(code) || code[test] != (instruction{"TESTL", "AL, AL"}) || branch >= len(code) || code[branch].op != "JE" {
		panic("feature check is not followed by TESTL and JE")
	}
	if _, ok := labels[code[branch].args]; !ok {
		panic("feature-false branch target is outside the fixture")
	}
	seen := make([]bool, len(code))
	work := []int{0}
	for len(work) != 0 {
		i := work[len(work)-1]
		work = work[:len(work)-1]
		if i >= len(code) || seen[i] {
			continue
		}
		seen[i] = true
		inst := code[i]
		if strings.HasPrefix(inst.op, "V") || strings.HasPrefix(inst.op, "K") {
			panic("vector instruction reachable with " + mode + " false")
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(inst.op, "J") {
			if target, ok := labels[inst.args]; ok {
				work = append(work, target)
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(inst.args, "0x") {
				panic("jump target is outside the fixture")
			}
		}
		// A false feature takes JE. Other conditional branches may take either
		// edge; direct jumps and returns have no fallthrough edge.
		if i != branch && inst.op != "JMP" && inst.op != "RET" {
			work = append(work, i+1)
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("guard excludes vectors", mode)
}

-- m/safe.txt --
fixture:1 0x10 e8 CALL simd/archsimd.X86Features.AVX512(SB)
fixture:2 0x11 84 TESTL AL, AL
fixture:3 0x12 74 JE 0x20
fixture:4 0x13 62 VPXORQ Z0, Z0, Z0
fixture:5 0x14 c3 RET
fixture:6 0x20 c3 RET

-- m/before-branch.txt --
fixture:1 0x10 e8 CALL simd/archsimd.X86Features.AVX512(SB)
fixture:2 0x11 62 VPXORQ Z0, Z0, Z0
fixture:3 0x12 84 TESTL AL, AL
fixture:4 0x13 74 JE 0x20
fixture:5 0x14 c3 RET
fixture:6 0x20 c3 RET

-- m/safe-alignment.txt --
fixture:1 0x10 e8 CALL simd/archsimd.X86Features.AVX512(SB)
fixture:2 0x11 0f NOPL 0(AX)
fixture:3 0x12 66 NOPW
fixture:4 0x13 84 TESTL AL, AL
fixture:5 0x14 90 NOP
fixture:6 0x15 74 JE 0x20
fixture:7 0x16 62 VPXORQ Z0, Z0, Z0
fixture:8 0x17 c3 RET
fixture:9 0x20 c3 RET

-- m/alignment-before-vector.txt --
fixture:1 0x10 e8 CALL simd/archsimd.X86Features.AVX512(SB)
fixture:2 0x11 0f NOPL 0(AX)
fixture:3 0x12 62 VPXORQ Z0, Z0, Z0
fixture:4 0x13 84 TESTL AL, AL
fixture:5 0x14 74 JE 0x20
fixture:6 0x15 c3 RET
fixture:7 0x20 c3 RET

-- m/alignment-before-clobber.txt --
fixture:1 0x10 e8 CALL simd/archsimd.X86Features.AVX512(SB)
fixture:2 0x11 84 TESTL AL, AL
fixture:3 0x12 0f NOPL 0(AX)
fixture:4 0x13 31 XORL AX, AX
fixture:5 0x14 74 JE 0x20
fixture:6 0x15 62 VPXORQ Z0, Z0, Z0
fixture:7 0x16 c3 RET
fixture:8 0x20 c3 RET

-- m/false-target.txt --
fixture:1 0x10 e8 CALL simd/archsimd.X86Features.AVX512(SB)
fixture:2 0x11 84 TESTL AL, AL
fixture:3 0x12 74 JE 0x20
fixture:4 0x13 c3 RET
fixture:5 0x20 62 VPXORQ Z0, Z0, Z0
fixture:6 0x21 c3 RET

-- g/go.mod --
module example.com/goguard

go 1.27

-- g/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"simd/archsimd"
)

//go:noinline
func zeroU8(chunks [][64]uint8) {
	for i := range chunks {
		if archsimd.X86.AVX512() {
			var zero archsimd.Uint8x64
			zero.StoreArray(&chunks[i])
		} else {
			chunks[i] = [64]uint8{}
		}
	}
}

//go:noinline
func zeroI32(chunks [][8]int32) {
	for i := range chunks {
		if archsimd.X86.AVX2() {
			var zero archsimd.Int32x8
			zero.StoreArray(&chunks[i])
		} else {
			chunks[i] = [8]int32{}
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	bytes := make([][64]uint8, 3)
	words := make([][8]int32, 3)
	for i := range bytes {
		for j := range bytes[i] {
			bytes[i][j] = uint8(i + j + 1)
		}
		for j := range words[i] {
			words[i][j] = int32(i + j + 1)
		}
	}
	zeroU8(bytes)
	zeroI32(words)
	for i := range bytes {
		if bytes[i] != [64]uint8{} || words[i] != [8]int32{} {
			panic("guarded zero differs from scalar oracle")
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("guarded Go zeros ok")
}
